title_en: Good News (9/20): A Lost Masterpiece Found
note_en: 不是…而是… means "not… but rather…" and corrects a wrong assumption: 这幅画不是一位无名画家的作品，而是一位著名大师的真迹 "the painting wasn't the work of an unknown artist, but a genuine piece by a famous master." Don't confuse it with 不但…而且… ("not only… but also"): 不是…而是… replaces the first idea, while 不但…而且… adds to it.
